blocks.title: Code duplication
blocks.text: Code duplication ka matlab ek hi code ka kai jagah dohraya jana hai; yeh dekh bhaal mushkil aur bugs paida karta hai, is liye ise dhoond kar hatana modular programming ka aham hissa hai.

blocks.title: main function
blocks.text: main function batata hai ke program kahan se shuru hota hai. Ise aam taur par aise block mein bulaya jata hai jo jaanchta hai ke file seedhi chalayi ja rahi hai ya module ke taur par import ho rahi hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)

blocks.text: main() sirf tab chalta hai jab file seedhi chalayi jaye, kahin aur import hone par nahi; yeh tareeqa kai modules wale bare projects mein mufeed hai.

blocks.prompt: File seedhi chalane par __name__ ki qeemat kya hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: "__main__"; file import hone par __name__ module ka apna naam hota hai.

items: Dohraya code na rakhein; if __name__ == "__main__": main() program sirf seedha chalne par shuru karta hai.
